en: The image shows a vintage postcard with an old colorized photograph of a European street. The foreground features a large ornate fountain decorated with statues of figures and sea creatures. The buildings lining the street are architecturally rich, featuring arched doorways, green shutters, stone facades with visible artwork, and a prominent building with a red-tiled dome. The scene is lively with a few people and a cart. Above the image, text in red reads: 'Trento. — Trient. Via Rodolfo Balanzaé.'
